# Requirements Quality Checklist: Autenticação do usuário único

**Purpose**: Valida a qualidade, clareza e completude dos requisitos da feature (unit tests para a escrita de requisitos).
**Created**: 2026-09-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Está definido o comportamento quando a sessão expira (redirecionar ao login)? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK002 - Está definido o critério de "senha forte" (tamanho mínimo / complexidade)? [Gap, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK003 - Está definido o fluxo de troca de senha (validação da senha atual)? [Completeness, Spec §US3, FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 - A "mensagem de erro genérica" do login está especificada (texto)? [Clarity, Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK005 - O "bloqueio progressivo" está quantificado (5 tentativas, 30 s, dobra)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 - O local de armazenamento do hash da senha está especificado? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 - A decisão "/version protegido" está consistente entre Clarifications, FR-005 e US6? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK008 - A decisão "bloqueio 5→30 s" está consistente entre Clarifications, FR-004 e SC-004? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 - A decisão "senha via UI" está consistente entre Clarifications, FR-009/010 e Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]

- [x] CHK027 - O esquema de rastreabilidade (FR-/SC-) está estabelecido? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
